title: Dear friends
description: Stella’s first letter on ego, divinity and keeping our eye on the way home.
body:
Dear friends, it has been about seven years since someone suggested I start a blog, and as I have been busy both with my spiritual practice and music career, I have finally decided to begin writing. I have had many messages and downloads since I began healing, and posted many “lives” at that time. I have recently felt propelled by the many recent “words of wisdom” on social media that have confirmed my thoughts and channeled messages to continue sharing here.

Our ego is important only in as much as it was given to us to engage for our human existence. We should not worship the ego! We are divine and connected as God’s children. Our human existence is to learn, grow, love and even enjoy as we keep our eye on the way home... not only “home” in the afterlife but even “home” here, in connection to our higher self and even with our spiritual tribe as warriors for the truth.

What is the truth? Jesus lived, died and rose again to remind us that we too must rise again in the consciousness of Christ and as spiritual children (yes, that was a download!). The more we connect and depend on our divinity, the more we are guided on the path that is meant for us.

What of manifestation? Manifestation should only be used as a dedicator to your dreams, aspirations and goals. You must not try to manifest something that is not ultimately meant for you. The “right” dream is already given to us, and all is manifested in perfect timing. Just keep doing the work.

Until next time...

Stella
